Here's a compact digest of recent developments from AI agent infrastructure vendors, focusing on protocol and bot-identity features within the last 14 days:

1.  **Anthropic Enhances Claude Enterprise MCP Security with Managed Identity Controls**
    Anthropic has made enterprise-managed authorization generally available for Claude Enterprise's Model Context Protocol (MCP) security capabilities. This update allows organizations to centrally provision and govern connector access through their identity provider (IdP), eliminating the need for individual users to authorize each MCP connector. Users now inherit connector access based on existing organizational permissions, enabling a zero-touch setup experience and extending enterprise identity controls to AI-connected business applications.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEzpBB7lEul4uEZ1yPJ1XDR12GNLUpWkMyQxdezM0h9emK0CnRGa98Sr5XbZQeyMMiwXAeaw_oOEY0sFivlrkA6ze38d7-cNWKhKjnCqpvQh0PdcmmuTMyVNdc8xT_fD8JW5aI2BY1X3EOsACKBDn6FnKNLbtgfC6z3EzzyLfzeorVA4XhJykZ-8QAhKZBnR_upA1bbNwotnHHfVGu8zGe4](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEzpBB7lEul4uEZ1yPJ1XDR12GNLUpWkMyQxdezM0h9emK0CnRGa98Sr5XbZQeyMMiwXAeaw_oOEY0sFivlrkA6ze38d7-cNWKhKjnCqpvQh0PdcmmuTMyVNdc8xT_fD8JW5aI2BY1X3EOsACKBDn6FnKNLbtgfC6z3EzzyLfzeorVA4XhJykZ-8QAhKZBnR_upA1bbNwotnHHfVGu8zGe4)

2.  **Anthropic's Claude Slack Agent Gains Proactive Capabilities and Federated Identity**
    A new update to Anthropic's Claude Tag allows its Slack agent to read full conversation context and proactively engage in discussions without explicit prompting. This enhancement leverages a federated agent identity with its own permissions and channel awareness, integrating with Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) for deeper contextual understanding from enterprise data systems. The system is designed with built-in restraint to avoid being disruptive.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGyKCJNYyZeRqNq82hMdnneE6iSw97bfass4z7NIyG7xCO-Gn9w2F9wQS3rcJq8ZN2Pz4P_jWUVnFYBqYYnMU2pNudDt4Ywf0w9HYrmYO2L9qTldSLIsKSOQcW6KaOAIGe4QGU3Y1o7ndNZRAN0o2ee_E23nN1VKDjqLGWb-PHXJSiuhTPLUn1CVNpxYCL-j3caLrwaJkWAwqx7VfiW_Zmt5vO-MGMXBYD17Wnt-Ibug0Lqyz9x72xqs6QgYOgGN3rbVgD3-dHYg==](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGyKCJNYyZeRqNq82hMdnneE6iSw97bfass4z7NIyG7xCO-Gn9w2F9wQS3rcJq8ZN2Pz4P_jWUVnFYBqYYnMU2pNudDt4Ywf0w9HYrmYO2L9qTldSLIsKSOQcW6KaOAIGe4QGU3Y1o7ndNZRAN0o2ee_E23nN1VKDjqG3Y1o7ndNZRAN0o2ee_E23nN1VKDjqLGWb-PHXJSiuhTPLUn1CVNpxYCL-j3caLrwaJkWAwqx7VfiW_Zmt5vO-MGMXBYD17Wnt-Ibug0Lqyz9x72xqs6QgYOgGN3rbVgD3-dHYg==)

3.  **Anthropic's Browser Use Tool Reaches General Availability**
    Anthropic has announced the general availability of its new browser use tool (`browser_toolset_20260801`) on the Claude API, alongside computer use (`computer_toolset_20260801`) also leaving beta. The browser use tool is a distinct client toolset for driving an application-hosted browser by reading its accessibility tree, setting form values directly, and managing tabs and downloads. This differs from computer use, which operates by reading pixels.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-J-aH7K0lLJ6vQalN3g6xU2Z_ALeIwSpPGesZj-ptc5Ppix7yeh3vZyM1JEssfZrMXPc8GniG27bUUkrw3rEZ15x1qRe5EReffswILEpkWqjrgvBGPR2Dtj8OcEdsOvonWgbwvkV8LJbY63gvu37RhTQ_8VYZKjwolzSkETrfBvwhea-H_ePYS1-zKGg=](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-J-aH7K0lLJ6vQalN3g6xU2Z_ALeIwSpPGesZj-ptc5Ppix7yeh3vZyM1JEssfZrMXPc8GniG27bUUkrw3rEZ15x1qRe5EReffswILEpkWqjrgvBGPR2Dtj8OcEdsOvonWgbwvkV8LJbY63gvu37RhTQ_8VYZKjwolzSkETrfBvwhea-H_ePYS1-zKGg=)

4.  **CrewAI Promotes Conversational Flows to Stable and Enhances Execution Context Management**
    CrewAI has promoted its declarative conversational flows to stable, making conversational mode more explicit and easier to drive from declarations. Additionally, the platform has introduced execution context management with UUID support, allowing for better tracking and management of agent deployments and workflows. These updates aim to improve the reliability and control over agent interactions and system operations.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG_Z7kTR5QHAE_yF7sTYDFLGOXUPS1LLeCKFqVSIPFb_3rHI775CN8U_1L-CDGkafNZqPv0-uh5R-6kdJCM0buT5tD8ox9ApOHEvBUF0b52fGpQxYKxG2gC54arzOR3qPwy1P2v-mC7](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG_Z7kTR5QHAE_yF7sTYDFLGOXUPS1LLeCKFqVSIPFb_3rHI775CN8U_1L-CDGkafNZqPv0-uh5R-6kdJCM0buT5tD8ox9ApOHEvBUF0b52fGpQxYKxG2gC54arzOR3qPwy1P2v-mC7) and [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE6TUJuRVh7YIpqtVswFRbHNmTHZ6i-1pi4FHOKyQbFEep1mB1TrK6jCRQHok12Ra7Khqt4vqfx-PmeKUqqxgtacpRQQ7T-k_6ln9Cg51ogsaIXqvjiPMXWXlJB6XP_Kzy42kvIoc8=](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE6TUJuRVh7YIpqtVswFRbHNmTHZ6i-1pi4FHOKyQbFEep1mB1TrK6jCRQHok12Ra7Khqt4vqfx-PmeKUqqxgtacpRQQ7T-k_6ln9Cg51ogsaIXqvjiPMXWXlJB6XP_Kzy42kvIoc8=)

5.  **LangChain Agent Server Introduces Enhanced Security and Tool Call Restrictions**
    The LangChain Agent Server has implemented new security features, including enforcing thread authorization filters during conditional thread creation on the Postgres runtime. It also added an `A2A_ALLOWED_TOOL_CALL_RESULTS` environment variable, allowing developers to restrict agent-to-agent (A2A) tool call results to an allowlist of tool names, enhancing control over agent actions and potential security vulnerabilities.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHIGsfqShn_krX_xPL-TNevVTI7VNU0kwa9gWEQH_nTovbUAJQ_HVQqJ7cddVVdPP81QYB4q0kz0oTgHZgPzmm3E1x7NziXLPl3rcdd5R6d0YUW6X9ob6P0D1F4GJ_03L2vdLdzmdX9C8bMNtOun6JxVW2Wa0M=](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHIGsfqShn_krX_xPL-TNevVTI7VNU0kwa9gWEQH_nTovbUAJQ_HVQqJ7cddVVdPP81QYB4q0kz0oTgHZgPzmm3E1x7NziXLPl3rcdd5R6d0YUW6X9ob6P0D1F4GJ_03L2vdLdzmdX9C8bMNtOun6JxVW2Wa0M=)

6.  **LangSmith Cloud Now Mints Managed Deep Agent Guest Tokens**
    LangSmith Chat has been updated to mint Managed Deep Agent guest tokens from the Chat LangChain LangGraph host. This change in the authentication flow for guest users interacting with Deep Agents through LangSmith Cloud improves the handling of bot identity and access within the LangChain ecosystem.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFl59aKVMx2GUPQUyypk7DMKr31sqlQc_pnwCKuqLveqAj8j07oTVgd4FIm_jxXw8yXp8qqvJW7nyyiuokrqW4TzX7npTtARAOQWzvx2hTFcvEXOQADjTTvMTBA6bQvQHsRKLC5tumaLg==](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFl59aKVMx2GUPQUyypk7DMKr31sqlQc_pnwCKuqLveqAj8j07oTVgd4FIm_jxXw8yXp8qqvJW7nyyiuokrqW4TzX7npTtARAOQWzvx2hTFcvEXOQADjTTvMTBA6bQvQHsRKLC5tumaLg==)

7.  **OpenAI Enhances Workspace and Identity Management for Enterprise and Edu Customers**
    OpenAI has introduced expanded workspace and identity settings in the Admin Console for eligible ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu customers. This includes the ability to manage workspace members, groups, roles, and permissions, as well as synchronize users and groups once through centralized, tenant-wide SCIM. These features provide organizations with more robust control over user access and bot identity within their ChatGPT deployments.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEhZOY8hB7WDT7mu5E5LE4BjGII93Fqrd9JukBsSxD9e0p87ACm1hCJngKvpniGyss_EmGl_cshwvgzmb9UMze4GqILxmDLQu--v0ono8y9kdyZnpndNda_LjkSHObf](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEhZOY8hB7WDT7mu5E5LE4BjGII93Fqrd9JukBsSxD9e0p87ACm1hCJngKvpniGyss_EmGl_cshwvgzmb9UMze4GqILxmDLQu--v0ono8y9kdyZnpndNda_LjkSHObf)

8.  **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) Focuses on Zero-Trust for AI Agents**
    Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) is emphasizing the development of "zero-trust AI agents" to mitigate security risks when agents interact with production systems. The framework helps developers manage the inherent risks of autonomous agents that determine their own execution paths using natural language, especially when performing actions like issuing refunds, modifying databases, or executing code. This approach aims to prevent prompt injection attacks and unauthorized actions by ensuring agents operate within strict security boundaries.
    Source: [https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH9aMk5TC6VG8j9O_Yz7rmGHyb3Wy4Rpu-6NZJDked_UPerZe8_uviX84kBj5SB5X-wSqALa68JdNEgMZDF_Kj4dpjV7Z5rEea3pK5Re40vPW00fd8qdA_1jNnVDTvcecdxK7S4uvBhvVvVkvlkgvsTuufT5FBEwHWqGmJHyGHnsgTKy1D2AQ0zChaRDC_Y5RNlcypTq2PGq6Q](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH9aMk5TC6VG8j9O_Yz7rmGHyb3Wy4Rpu-6NZJDked_UPerZe8_uviX84kBj5SB5X-wSqALa68JdNEgMZDF_Kj4dpjV7Z5rEea3pK5Re40vPW00fd8qdA_1jNnVDTvcecdxK7S4uvBhvVvVkvlkgvsTuufT5FBEwHWqGmJHyGHnsgTKy1D2AQ0zChaRDC_Y5RNlcypTq2PGq6Q)

previous_content:
Here's a compact digest of new features, integrations, and announcements from AI agent infrastructure vendors, focusing on protocol and bot-identity features, from April 5, 2026, to April 19, 2026:

1.  **Anthropic Ships Computer Use for Claude**
    Anthropic has released a new "computer use" mode for Claude, enabling the AI agent to browse the web, open files, navigate workflows, and execute tasks on behalf of users. This feature significantly expands Claude's autonomous capabilities for automating real-world work.

2.  **Anthropic Restricts Third-Party Agent Subscriptions**
    Anthropic has implemented a change that prevents Claude subscriptions from being used with third-party agents like OpenClaw. Users are now required to utilize pay-as-you-go API rates for such integrations, potentially leading to increased costs.

3.  **OpenAI SDK Update Introduces Sandboxing for Safer Agent Deployment**
    OpenAI has launched a significant SDK update that includes sandboxing capabilities, designed to enhance the security of AI agents. This allows developers to safely connect frontier models to files and approved tools, streamlining secure deployment for companies.

4.  **Google Releases Agentic Tools for Android Developers**
    Google has introduced new agentic tools for Android developers, aimed at improving efficiency by using 70% fewer tokens and completing tasks three times faster. These tools provide developers with new command-line interface (CLI) skills and access to official knowledge bases for building more intelligent software.

5.  **Google Chrome Skills Integrate Gemini for Persistent Web Automation**
    Google Chrome has launched "Chrome Skills," which integrate with Gemini to allow users to save and reuse AI prompts across various websites. This functionality transforms the browser into a personalized AI workflow engine, enabling persistent automation of repetitive web tasks.

6.  **CrewAI v1.10.1 Adds Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Support**
    CrewAI has released version 1.10.1, which now includes native support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. This update allows role-based agents within CrewAI to invoke and manage MCP integrations, enhancing multi-agent orchestration capabilities.

7.  **Microsoft Launches Agent Framework 1.0.0**
    Microsoft has released Agent Framework 1.0.0, which redefines how developers construct AI agents by separating agent control from the application. This new architectural approach simplifies connecting agents to pre-configured systems within Azure, aiming to reduce technical friction in adoption.

8.  **OpenAI Codex Enterprise Offers MCP and Multi-Agent Workflows**
    OpenAI has launched Codex Enterprise, providing dedicated Codex-only seats for ChatGPT Enterprise users. This offering includes Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, multi-agent workflows, and deep integration with enterprise systems, featuring token-based billing and no rate limits.

9.  **Agent SRE 3.1.0 Public Preview for Autonomous Agent Reliability**
    Agent SRE 3.1.0 has entered public preview, focusing on reliability engineering for autonomous agent systems. This update introduces Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets tailored to agent performance, chaos testing for resilience, progressive delivery for safer deployments, and real-time monitoring of agent health.

10. **VerifiMind-PEAS Deploys MACP v2.2 Coordination Tools**
    VerifiMind-PEAS has deployed three new Multi-Agent Coordination Protocol (MACP) v2.2 coordination tools as part of its Pioneer-gated premium tier. These tools, `coordination_handoff_create`, `coordination_handoff_read`, and `coordination_team_status`, facilitate enhanced multi-agent collaboration and management.

11. **OpenClaw 2026.4.9 Enhances Multi-Agent Framework with MCP and Role-Based Agents**
    OpenClaw has updated its multi-agent trading framework to version 2026.4.9, introducing enhanced capabilities such as autonomous web scraping of market feeds and role-based agent decomposition (analyst, executor, risk monitor). The update also features Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible orchestration and agent state persistence.

## Cited sources
1. [aiagentstore.ai](https://aiagentstore.ai/ai-agent-news/2026-april)
2. [yutori.com](https://scouts.yutori.com/inbox/51a4aa00-5385-489e-ab54-e8eae44000c1)
3. [agentapihub.com](https://agentapihub.com/)

5. [github.com](https://github.com/creator35lwb-web/VerifiMind-PEAS)
6. [yutori.com](https://scouts.yutori.com/inbox/d6bc8bd5-67c1-412f-aed5-9432e3b8d39b)
